R.name: Transform Mercury Cannon
R.title: Template:Data Jayce/Transform Mercury Cannon
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Transform Mercury Cannon|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Jayce
|skill        = R
|icon         = Transform Mercury Cannon.png
|blurbicon    = Transform Mercury Cannon.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Jayce}} transforms into {{cci|Transform Mercury Cannon.png||{{sbc|Cannon Stance}}}}, becoming {{tip|ranged}} with greater {{sti|attack range}} and gaining new {{tip|abilities}}.
|blurb2       = His next {{tip|basic attack}} will reduce the target's {{sti|lethality|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|mpen|{{as|magic resist}}}} for a few seconds.
|blurb4       = '''Jayce''' begins the game with ''Transform'' but cannot increase its rank. Instead, his basic abilities each have 6 ranks.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Jayce''' transforms into {{cci|Transform Mercury Cannon.png||{{sbc|Cannon Stance}}}}, receiving access to its {{tip|abilities}}, becoming {{tip|ranged}} with {{sti|500 attack range}}, and empowering his next {{tip|basic attack}} to reduce the target's {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance}}}} by {{pp|key=%|20 to 35 for 4|1 to 16}} for 5 seconds.
|description2  = {{Data Jayce/Transform Mercury Hammer|pst2|description2}}
|cooldown     = 6
|targeting    = Auto
|cast time    = none
|affects      = Self
|damagetype   = 
|spelleffects =
|parry        = true
|spellshield  = 
|notes        = 
* Transformations do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
* The resistance reduction does not apply to structures.
* Both ''Transform'' on-hit effects have no set duration and will only be consumed when ''Jayce'' either lands a basic attack or switches stances.
* The enhanced attack will not be consumed if it is parried ({{tip|dodge}}, {{tip|block}}, {{tip|blind}}, and {{ai|Riposte|Fiora}}).
* The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|structures}} nor {{tip|wards}}.
|flavorsound = {{sm2|Jayce_Original_R_HammerToCannon_1.ogg}} ''"Cannon engaged."''
}}
